title: Using the Survival Codex
summary: The Codex gathers ECHO articles, discoveries, regions, hazards, missions, factions, and related Index records.

sections.title: What It Shows
sections.body: Articles are datapack-driven. Dynamic pages are assembled from EchoCore services, so optional addons can appear without the Wiki hardcoding their content.

sections.title: Locked Intel
sections.body: Discovery-linked entries show safe hints until the owning feature is discovered.
